fusions.name: Reel In
fusions.desc: Throws a hatchet on a length of chain that deals 12 damage to the first enemy it meets, then reels you to it from up to 7 tiles away.

fusions.name: Swung on a Tether
fusions.desc: Swings the axe on its chain, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles. The swing then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Snare Line
fusions.desc: Stretches a chain 6 tiles long ahead of you for 5 seconds that drags every enemy near it inward. Anything it catches moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Links Pulled Taut
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, your physical damage rises 20% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds. Anything you strike moves 15% slower for 2 seconds.
